t: Bassinet Buying Guide: Types, Safety & Expert Tips via @ConsumerReports
s: May 1, 2025 - You can rest assured that bassinets sold in the U.S. must conform to federally regulated standards that stipulate that bassinets and cradles have certain features for safety. Those include, among other factors, that the product is strong enough to hold the weight of the baby; stable enough to ensure that it won’t tip over, including in the case of a sibling holding on to the side; and for products that move, that the rocking or swinging angle doesn’t increase the likelihood of the baby becoming trapped in the side of the bassinet.
